title: Effects of vitrectomy combined with internal limiting membrane peeling in patients with diabetic macular edema
condition: Diabetic macular edema, 81 patients (92 eyes), Beijing Shanqu Liangxiang Hospital, 2022; Methods describe a retrospective review with allocation by computer-generated random number sequences to PPV alone or PPV with ILM peeling; no previous laser, anti-VEGF, vitrectomy, cataract or other intraocular surgery; inclusion required follow-up of at least 6 months and complete clinical data

groups.agent: 23-gauge three-port pars plana vitrectomy with triamcinolone staining; silicone oil tamponade and subconjunctival dexamethasone/gentamicin at the end of surgery (Methods)
groups.description: Control group: PPV alone, 41 patients / 47 eyes

groups.agent: pars plana vitrectomy plus internal limiting membrane peeling (0.1% indocyanine green staining, peeling range 2 disc diameters)
groups.description: Stripping group: PPV with ILM peeling, 40 patients / 45 eyes

series.notes: Mean +/- SD; times from surgery (1 and 3 months after surgery); n per visit not given separately from the row label (n = 47); values are not stated as removed after complications (retinal detachment, endophthalmitis)
Mean +/- SD; times from surgery (1 and 3 months after surgery); n per visit not given separately from the row label (n = 45); values are not stated as removed after complications

exclusions.what: Table 2 rows 5-6 (t and P) and columns 5-6 (F and P of repeated-measures ANOVA)
exclusions.reason: Test statistics and p-values are not extracted

exclusions.what: Table 4 volume of cystoid macular edema
exclusions.reason: Volume measured by B-mode ultrasonography, not central thickness by OCT (out of scope)

notes: Measure: Methods state CMT was measured manually on OCT at the fovea (retinal thickness from ILM to RPE), three measurements averaged; recorded as central_point (manual foveal measurement, not the 1-mm subfield mean).
Design wording is inconsistent: retrospective review in Methods, random allocation in Methods and abstract; recorded as stated.
Complication counts differ between the abstract and the Results text; not extracted.
Role: the stripping group (ILM peeling added) is the declared experimental arm; PPV alone is labelled the control group by the authors.
